data.name: Luaynah
data.gender_notes: Luaynah is used as a female name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Luaynah is derived from the Arabic words 'Lu' meaning 'Light' and 'Ayn' meaning 'Sky'. It translates to 'Light of the Sky'. The name Luaynah carries the meaning “Light of the Sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Luaynah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name holds the divine message of guiding humanity with the light of wisdom and knowledge.
data.etymology: Luaynah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luaynah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: لُيَيْنَة
in_arabic.meaning: لينة تعني اللين والسهولة والرقة في التعامل

Historically, the name Luaynah has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the values of humility and warmth.
